summary: Wikipedia as an anchor (brief 2026-10-25), released as v0.17.0: admin/wikipedia/fetch.py fetched all 364 revisions of the PHP2Shell article, its Wikidata item Q141801185 and the 198 articles linking in; admin/build/wikitext.py reads a revision as one statement per sentence, classed by wording, with its references; /wikipedia/ with the article as a graph (the ontology's wikipedia scope, joined to the story graph by captured_as, zooms both ways), every statement with its evidence, every reference (16 of 42 captured here, 26 not), every edit as what it changed; 25 new parties; the daily pass fetches Wikipedia first; board 288 to 295. Checked in Chromium (16 new checks, 37 old) and by the gate. Security's self-check done after the release, not before, and recorded in admin/content/agents/ontologist/debriefs/2026-10-25__self-check-wikipedia.md (security has no member id to message): the one item is that the daily pass reads Wikipedia's API and releases (REQUIREMENTS section 7). Collisions: release.sh stopped once on data/admin.json; solved by hand, the Wikipedia rows renumbered 288 to 295; a first resolution dropped five rows and was redone.
